column4: the newest complete lineage of a file can be a reviewed hash-pinned postimage that the donor main path never received (m3-sparse-java-first-completion-20261026: manifest before = the main path's sha256); the recipe accepts a .java.txt FILE source and the differential replays the superseded main path as a second donor, so the lineage choice is a mechanical observation (one COMPUTED_LIST line differs), not a claim

column4: package-private atoms (M3SparseUtf16Stitched and its static methods) are reached by getDeclaredMethod + setAccessible from a dump in another package: on the class path every class sits in the unnamed module, so the donor package and the relocated package run the same driver

the oracle's verify() report (a record) prints as Report[...] on both sides: the record's simple name, not its package, so a donor-package oracle and the relocated oracle produce byte-identical report lines
mvn.cmd under Git Bash may exit 0 on a failed build, so verify.sh never trusts the exit code: BUILD SUCCESS must be in the log, and compiler warnings and [ERROR] lines are counted from the log
